# Earlier FF7 source recovery

The earlier FF7 project was an executable preservation/remaster and headless story-replay project. Its known checkpoint names are retained in `recovery_manifest.json`, but no exact archive has been resolved in the current Library or connected GitHub searches. No earlier source code, original disc assets, or authenticated replay data have been recovered or copied into this repository in this step.

The manifest records the actual title/content searches, archive inventory limits, and connected repository checks. These failures establish a current recovery limitation, not that the historical files never existed. A new original ROM adaptation must remain distinguished from a source-code port until the archive is available.

The smallest named recovery candidate is `P37-CHECKPOINT-STORY618-KURO7-DWARF-BIT3-SOURCE-AUTH.zip`, if it contains the consolidated headless runtime and its data. The latest complete consolidated FF7 source archive is preferred; the v0.13.5 Nibelheim checkpoint is an earlier fallback. Preserve the source runtime, data contracts, and authenticated playthrough ledger when recovering it.
